Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Appellant :- Surendra Narayan Mishra Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Pathak,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.G.A. representing the State-respondent.

2. Instant criminal appeal under Section 14-A(1) of S.C./S.T. (P.A.) Act, 1989 has been preferred on behalf of the appellant assailing the Cognizance order dated 23.01.2023 and Charge sheet dated 19.05.2022 in Session Case No.241 of 2023, (State Vs. Ashwani Dheeman) under Sections 406, 420,
504, 506 IPC and 3(2)(5) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989 (Amendment Act 2015), Police Station-Nakur, District-Saharanpur, pending in the Court of Special Judge (SC/ST Act), Saharanpur.
Ashwani Dheeman vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157483446/
1 3.

entities.label: COURT

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After due deliberation at length, learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that he is not pursuing the instant appeal on merits.
He has further submitted that the present appellant is ready and willing to co-operate with the courts below and participate in the court proceedings provided some protection may be granted to him.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by the present appellant to enable him to appear before the court below.
5. In this conspectus, as above, no useful purpose would be served to keep this matter pending,

therefore, this Court deems it appropriate to finally dispose of the present appeal, without making any observation on the merits of the case as mentioned in the present appeal, with a direction that the present appellants, in case, appear/surrender and move a bail application before the court below within a period of three weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order, the same shall be considered and decided by the court concerned in accordance with law expeditiously, preferably,
within a period of three weeks thereafter. .
6. For a period of six weeks or till the decision on the bail application, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the present appellant.

7. With this observation, instant appeal stands finally disposed of.
Order Date :- 10.6.2025/vkg  Ashwani Dheeman vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157483446/
